## Summary

Describe the behavior change and why it belongs in LOOP.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Targeted test command passes
- [ ] No runtime logs, credentials, private paths, or generated ledgers included
- [ ] Declared policy and enforcement code remain aligned
- [ ] Windows and Linux/WSL impact considered

## Safety and rollback

List affected hooks, configuration, persistent state, compatibility boundaries, and the exact rollback path.

## Release gate

- [ ] This change does not reduce test counts or weaken an existing gate without explicit maintainer approval
- [ ] Human-triggered release remains the final authority
